# TP-Link Cloud
> TP-Link Cloud provides cloud-connected account, device, and remote management services for TP-Link products.

This site supports TP-Link cloud login, account services, and connected device access used by TP-Link consumer networking and smart home products.

## Core Cloud Pages
- [Cloud Home](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/): Main TP-Link Cloud landing page for account access and cloud-connected services.
- [Login](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/login.php): Sign in to a TP-Link Cloud account.
- [Register](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/register.php): Create a new TP-Link Cloud account.
- [Forgot Password](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/forget.php): Recover access to a TP-Link Cloud account.
- [Reset Password](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/reset.php): Complete TP-Link Cloud password reset flow.

## Account Management
- [Account Information](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/user.php): View and manage TP-Link Cloud account details.
- [Change Password](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/modifyPassword.php): Update the password for a TP-Link Cloud account.
- [Email Verification](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/verify.php): Verify the email address associated with a cloud account.
- [Logout](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/logout.php): End the current TP-Link Cloud session.

## Device and Cloud Access
- [Device List](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/device.php): View devices linked to the current TP-Link Cloud account.
- [Remote Management](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/webpages/index.html): Access browser-based cloud device management interface.
- [Cloud Service Portal](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/webpages/): Entry point for TP-Link Cloud web application resources.

## Support and Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/privacy.php): Review TP-Link Cloud privacy and data handling terms.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/terms.php): Read terms governing TP-Link Cloud service usage.
- [Help](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/help.php): Access TP-Link Cloud help and support information.
- [Contact](https://www.tplinkcloud.com/contact.php): Find contact information for TP-Link Cloud support.

## TP-Link Ecosystem
- [TP-Link Global](https://www.tp-link.com/): Main TP-Link corporate and product website.
- [TP-Link Support](https://www.tp-link.com/support/): Product support, downloads, and troubleshooting resources.
- [TP-Link Download Center](https://www.tp-link.com/support/download/): Firmware, utilities, and manuals for TP-Link devices.
- [TP-Link Community](https://community.tp-link.com/): Community discussions for TP-Link networking and smart home products.

## Mobile App Ecosystem
- [Tether App](https://www.tp-link.com/home-networking/tether/): Mobile app for managing TP-Link routers and extenders.
- [Kasa Smart](https://www.kasasmart.com/): Smart home app and ecosystem for Kasa devices.
- [Tapo](https://www.tapo.com/): Smart home platform for Tapo cameras, plugs, and automation devices.
